note: Which qualities each game measures and how. Scores 0-100, confidence 0-1 (n/(n+k)), 'rough' below 0.5. Gameplay estimates for picking a game, not assessments of a person.

measures.focus: 100*(1 - sum(w*rate)/sum(w)); rates = obstacle hits/obstacles faced, crow hits/crows faced, coins missed/coins offered; weights in runner/tuning.json focus.weights (3/2/1)
measures.reaction: crows avoided / crows faced (obstacle clear rate if < 3 crows)

measures.*: tetris + pairwise adapters on one log

measures.decisionSpeed: median decision time, log scale 5 s=100 .. 90 s=0
measures.consistency: repeat pairs agreeing (only when a pair was answered twice; transitivity check: TODO when sets have triangles)

measures.reaction: median spawn->first touch, log scale 0.8 s=100 .. 6 s=0
measures.decisionSpeed: median spawn->commit, log scale 1 s=100 .. 8 s=0 (merged with A/B questions)
measures.accuracy: anchor (clear-cut) parcels sorted to their expected bin
measures.endurance: 50 + 8*slope(wave focus) per wave (speed rises every wave)

yields: mail-triage sorts that grade the Ollama models' bin predictions
